text_block_list.text:
Oh! Ahem... Please forget you heard
that.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
First place is to be expected. I am a
member of
the Mejiro family, after all.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It is much too early to celebrate. I have
yet to
achieve my task.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I can't let the fact that I got first
place...
Hehe!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: You did it! You really did it!
Let's aim for even greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: You did it! You really did it!
Let's aim for even greater heights!

text_block_list.text: Y-you don't have to be so loud! Aren't you a little too happy?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
This really is not the time to lose focus.
You really
are hopeless sometimes... ♪
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Besides, if you get so excited over every
little
thing, you'll wear yourself out.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. And it seems you're
plenty
prepared for what's to come.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
This win is but a single checkpoint on
the road to
my next goal.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I will climb even higher! I will be more
beautiful,
more graceful, and even more
perfect!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
There are still a number of victories in
waiting
that will be worthy of
celebration.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
